ledger.departmentNotFound: The department on line {row} wasn't found or is inactive.
ledger.dimensionValueNotFound: The dimension value on line {row} wasn't found.
ledger.dimensionValueEnded: Dimension value {value} (line {row}) had ended by the entry date.

ledger.vatRateNotFound: The VAT code on line {row} wasn't found.
ledger.locked: The period is locked – you can't post entries on {date}.
ledger.closedYear: The financial year is closed – you can't post entries on {date}.
ledger.noFiscalYear: {date} isn't in any financial year. Add a financial year.

ledger.notPosted: Only posted entries can be reversed.

errors.emailFailed: The email couldn't be sent. Check the address and try again.

sales.itemNotFound: The item on line {row} wasn't found.

sales.quoteInvoiced: This quote has already been invoiced.
sales.vatAccountMissing: VAT code {vat} has no output VAT account. Set it in VAT settings.

errors.emailNotConfigured: Email sending isn't set up: add RESEND_API_KEY and EMAIL_FROM to the Vercel environment variables.

validation.vatNumber: A VAT number starts with a country code, e.g. EE100000000.

validation.days: Enter a number of days between 0 and 365.

auth.heroTitle: Bookkeeping that keeps track for you.
auth.heroBody: One place for the invoices, payments, entries and reports of all your companies.
auth.linkError: That sign-in link is no longer valid. Request a new one.
auth.magicLinkHint: We'll email you a link to sign in without a password. The link is valid for 15 minutes.
auth.checkEmailBody: If an account exists for {email}, we've sent a sign-in link there.
auth.registerSubtitle: Creating an account is free. You can add a company in the next step.
auth.registerInviteSubtitle: Create an account to accept the invitation.
auth.name: Name
auth.organizationNameHint: If you keep the books for several companies, enter your firm's name here.

invite.invalidBody: The invitation has expired, was revoked or was already used. Ask the sender for a new one.
invite.title: Invitation: {company}
invite.body: You were invited as {email} with the role “{role}”.
invite.mismatch: You're signed in as {current}, but the invitation was sent to {invited}. Sign out and use the right account.

descriptions.OWNER: Full access, including users and permissions.
descriptions.ACCOUNTANT: All accounting work, including confirming documents and closing periods.
descriptions.EDITOR: Can create and edit drafts but cannot confirm them.
descriptions.VIEWER: Can see data and reports but cannot change anything.

palette.title: Command palette

dashboard.subtitle: Overview: {company}
dashboard.denied: You don't have access to that view. Ask the company owner if you need it.
dashboard.checklistBody: These steps make daily work easier. You can start invoicing right away and finish them later.

fiscalYear.body: When your reporting year starts and ends.

accounts.title: Review the chart of accounts
accounts.body: We start from the Estonian standard chart, which you can adjust.

banks.title: Add bank and cash accounts
banks.body: Then you can import statements and match payments.

openingBalances.title: Enter opening balances
openingBalances.body: Moving from another system? Bring over the previous period's balances.

users.title: Invite colleagues
users.body: Give your accountant or management access with a suitable role.

dashboard.deadlinesNote: The annual report deadline appears once the financial year is set up.

receivables.title: Unpaid sales invoices

payables.title: Bills to pay
payables.empty: What to pay and when will appear here.

bank.title: Bank and cash
bank.empty: Account balances and shortcuts will appear here.

comingSoon.title: This part is in progress
comingSoon.body: This view arrives in development phase {phase}. Meanwhile, the finished parts are ready to use.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The address is wrong or you don't have access to it.

companies.name: Company name
companies.vatNumberHint: Leave empty if the company isn't VAT registered.
companies.listSubtitle: Pick the company whose books you want to work on.
companies.emptyBody: Add your first company or ask a colleague to invite you.
companies.newSubtitle: Start with the basics. You'll set up the chart of accounts, VAT and financial year next.
companies.settingsSubtitle: These details appear on invoices and reports.
companies.basicDataBody: Name, registry code and VAT number.
companies.documentLocaleHint: Language of invoices and other documents when the customer has no language set.
companies.accountingSetupBody: Settings chosen when the company was created; they define the chart of accounts and report layout.
companies.accountingStartHint: Opening balances are entered as of the previous day.

users.title: Users and permissions
users.subtitle: Who can access the data of {company}.

setup.title: Accounting setup is missing
setup.body: We'll create an Estonian company chart of accounts, VAT rates with validity periods, a financial year, document numbering and dimensions. You can change everything later.
setup.askOwner: Ask the company owner or accountant to create the setup.

accounts.subtitle: General ledger accounts, how they map to reports, and their default VAT.
accounts.name: Name
accounts.systemHint: The app uses this account in automatic entries (e.g. receivables, VAT, profit for the year).

kindHints.DETAIL: Entries can be posted to this account.
kindHints.SUMMARY: Totals the accounts whose code starts with this code. No postings.

accounts.isPaymentMethodHint: A bank or cash account that can be chosen as the means of payment on invoices.
accounts.activeHint: Inactive accounts aren't offered when entering transactions.

reportLines.IS_INVENTORY_CHANGE: Change in finished goods and work in progress
reportLines.IS_DEPRECIATION: Depreciation and impairment of non-current assets

vat.subtitle: VAT rates, their validity periods and linked accounts.
vat.explain: The rate is picked by document date. When the law changes a rate, add a new validity period – there's no need to update items or accounts.
vat.name: Name

kindHints.TAXABLE: Regular supply at a rate – reported on the rate lines of the VAT return.
kindHints.ZERO_EXPORT: Export of goods outside the EU.
kindHints.ZERO_EU_GOODS: Goods sold to a taxable person in another member state; also in the EC sales list.
kindHints.EU_SERVICES: Services to a taxable person in another member state; the buyer accounts for VAT.
kindHints.EXEMPT: Supply exempt from VAT by law (VAT Act § 16).
kindHints.REVERSE_CHARGE: Metal and real estate transactions etc. – no VAT on the invoice, the buyer accounts for it.
kindHints.NOT_TAXABLE: Transaction not reported on the VAT return.
kindHints.MARGIN: Second-hand goods or travel services: no VAT shown on the invoice, tax is calculated on the margin.

vat.deductibleHint: Share of input VAT that can be deducted (e.g. 50% for passenger cars).
vat.invoiceNoteHint: Shown next to the rate on invoices (e.g. a legal reference).
vat.periodsHint: Leave the end date empty if the rate still applies. Periods must not overlap.

fiscal.subtitle: Financial years and period locking.
fiscal.yearsBody: Entries can only be posted to an open financial year.
fiscal.closeConfirm: Close the financial year? Once closed, entries in this year can't be added or changed.
fiscal.lockBody: For example, lock the previous month after filing the VAT return so nobody changes its data by accident.
fiscal.lockedNow: Everything up to {date} is currently locked.
fiscal.lengthHint: Usually 12 months. When founding or changing the year, a financial year can be up to 18 months.

series.subtitle: Document numbering by document type.
series.hint: With per-year numbering the counter restarts every calendar year and numbers look like year/number. “Digits” pads the number with zeros (e.g. 4 → 0007).

currencies.subtitle: Currencies the company trades in and their exchange rates.
currencies.selectedBody: The base currency is EUR. Add the currencies you invoice or receive invoices in.
currencies.ecbExplain: Documents use the rate for the document date or the latest earlier day.
currencies.manualBody: Use when there's no ECB rate (e.g. a weekend, or the bank used a different rate).

dimensions.subtitle: Departments and custom dimensions for a finer split of income and expenses.
dimensions.departmentsBody: Split invoices and entries by department.
dimensions.dimensionsBody: For example projects and cost centres. Each entry line can have one value from each dimension.
dimensions.debitPositiveHint: Choose for tracking costs (e.g. a cost centre). Leave unchecked for tracking income (e.g. a project).
dimensions.name: Name
dimensions.endDateHint: After this date the value isn't offered on transactions.

opening.subtitle: General ledger balances at the start of accounting.
opening.explain: Enter the balances of all balance sheet accounts. If you start mid-year, also enter income and expense balances – the profit for the year is calculated from them.
opening.onlyFilled: Show only accounts with a balance
opening.csvHint: The CSV file needs the columns Account, Debit and Credit (separator ; , or tab). From Excel, save as “CSV UTF-8”.

csv.header: Couldn't find the Account, Debit and Credit columns.
csv.amount: The file has an invalid amount.
csv.unknownAccounts: These accounts aren't in the chart: {codes}

journal.newSubtitle: A manual general ledger entry. Save it as a draft or post it right away.
journal.draftSubtitle: A draft doesn't affect the ledger until it's posted.
journal.listSubtitle: All general ledger entries – manual ones and those created by documents.
journal.emptyBody: Manual entries appear here, and later also entries from invoices and payments.
journal.copied: The copy is open as a draft.
journal.reverseBody: A new entry is created with debit and credit swapped. The original entry stays and both are linked.
journal.templateMissingAccounts: Accounts {codes} aren't in the chart – please choose them yourself.
journal.replaceLinesConfirm: Replace the current lines with the template lines?
journal.templateHint: A template remembers the accounts, sides and any amounts entered. A template with the same name is overwritten.

leaseReclass.name: Current portion of finance lease
leaseReclass.hint: From long-term to short-term per payment schedule

investmentUp.name: Increase in investment value
investmentUp.hint: Fair value at the balance sheet date

investmentDown.name: Decrease in investment value
investmentDown.hint: Fair value or write-off of the sold part

inputVatCorrection.name: Input VAT adjustment
inputVatCorrection.hint: Proportional VAT, passenger cars – VAT return line 10

accruedExpense.name: Accrued expense
accruedExpense.hint: A cost of the period invoiced later

prepaidExpense.name: Prepaid expense allocation
prepaidExpense.hint: Current month's share of a prepaid cost

holidayAccrual.name: Holiday pay accrual
holidayAccrual.hint: Unused holiday liability at period end

statutoryReserve.name: Statutory reserve
statutoryReserve.hint: From retained earnings to statutory reserve

dividend.name: Dividends and income tax
dividend.hint: Dividend payable and dividend income tax

journal.openDocument: Open the document this entry came from

reports.unbalancedNote: Attention: totals don't balance – please contact support.
reports.pnlNote: Income and expense accounts start from zero at the beginning of the financial year; earlier years' result is in the retained earnings opening balance.
reports.truncated: The report has very many lines – showing the first 5,000. Narrow the period or choose an account.
reports.name: Name

groups.name: Group name
groups.deleteConfirm: Delete the group “{name}”? Records stay, just without a group.

customers.listSubtitle: Customers you send invoices and quotes to.
customers.newSubtitle: The name, code, address and payment terms go on the invoice.
customers.editSubtitle: Changes apply to new documents; earlier invoices stay as they are.
customers.search: Search by name, registry code or email
customers.emptyBody: Add your first customer – or do it right while writing an invoice.
customers.name: Name
customers.emailHint: Invoices and quotes are sent to this address.
customers.isPersonHint: The code field isn't labelled as a company registry code on the invoice.
customers.referenceNumberHint: If empty, the reference is made from the invoice number.
customers.localeHint: The invoice PDF and email are in this language.
customers.defaultVatHint: E.g. an EU services customer – applies to new lines.
customers.activeHint: Inactive customers aren't offered on new documents.
customers.quickHint: You can add the rest of the details later on the customer card.

items.listSubtitle: Goods and services – shared between sales and purchases.
items.emptyBody: An item remembers its name, price, unit, VAT and accounts – so invoicing goes faster.
items.name: Name
items.deactivated: The item has been used on documents, so it was marked inactive instead.

invoices.listSubtitle: Sales invoices, credit notes and prepayment invoices.
invoices.newSubtitle: A draft doesn't affect the books. On confirmation the invoice gets its number and ledger entry.
invoices.prepaymentSubtitle: The prepayment is recorded on the customer prepayments account and deducted on the final invoice.
invoices.draftSubtitle: A draft can be changed freely. A confirmed invoice can only be corrected with a credit note.
invoices.search: Search by number, customer, reference or line
invoices.emptyBody: Create your first sales invoice – you can add the customer and items right on the invoice.
invoices.yourReferenceHint: E.g. an order number – shown on the invoice.
invoices.notesHint: Shown below the lines, e.g. thanks or delivery terms.
invoices.marginVat: Margin scheme VAT (not shown on the invoice)
invoices.lineInvalid: Check line {row}: quantity, price and discount must be numbers.
invoices.creditInfo: This is a credit note for invoice {number}. Quantities are negative; VAT uses the original invoice's rate.
invoices.taxFreeInfo: Tax-free correction for invoice {number}: the sale to a traveller becomes a 0% export and the VAT is refunded.
invoices.creditBody: A credit note draft is created with the invoice lines (negative quantities). Review the lines, adjust quantities if needed and confirm.
invoices.taxFreeBody: Use when the traveller has confirmed the export of the goods. A credit note draft cancels the taxable sale and adds the same amount as a 0% export.
invoices.copied: The copy is open as a draft.

quotes.listSubtitle: Quotes – an accepted quote becomes an invoice with one click.
quotes.newSubtitle: A quote doesn't affect the books.
quotes.editSubtitle: A quote that has been invoiced can't be changed.
quotes.emptyBody: Write a quote and send it to the customer as a PDF.

invoiceSettings.subtitle: What invoices say by default and how they look.
invoiceSettings.cardBody: Applies to new documents. The payment term and late interest can be set per customer on the customer card.
invoiceSettings.lateInterestHint: Shown on the invoice; interest calculation arrives in phase 7.
invoiceSettings.bankDetailsHint: Bank and IBAN in the invoice footer. In phase 5 the company's bank accounts will appear here.
invoiceSettings.noteHint: Added to new invoices, e.g. “Thank you for your business!”
invoiceSettings.footerHint: Small text at the bottom of the page, e.g. your website or slogan.

documentEmail.prepaymentBody: Please find attached prepayment invoice {number} for {total}.
documentEmail.quoteBody: Thank you for your interest! Please find attached our quotation {number} for {total}.
documentEmail.paymentWithReference: Please pay by {dueDate} using reference number {reference}.
